Hi Elena — thanks for sending these over, appreciated. A couple quick clarifications so we can complete the vendor master setup: 

1) Can you confirm the tax classification for Acme Circuits, Inc. — US C-Corp (EIN) vs. UK operating entity? Our tax team needs the exact legal entity name that will appear on invoices.
2) Please attach a completed W-9 (for US entity) — the certificate and VAT doc are helpful but we still need the W-9 for AP.
3) AP remit contact looks like Maria Lopez — can you share a direct phone number and confirm ACH routing/account name exactly as it should appear in our system?
4) We do request at least one proof of site presence (photo or utility bill). If you can attach a short site verification photo that works.

Once we have the W-9 and confirm the EIN/legal name, I will create the vendor record and route PO/invoicing to Vanessa (cc'd) for payment lane assignment. Karthik, tagging you for any special PO approval or preferred routing rules for hardware vendors.

Thanks — Soojin
